name: XlChartSplitType
description: Specifies the values displayed in the second chart in a pie chart or a Bar of Pie chart.

constants.name: xlSplitByPosition
constants.description: Second chart displays the smallest values in the data series. The number of values to display is specified by the SplitValue property.

constants.name: xlSplitByPercentValue
constants.description: Second chart displays values less than some percentage of the total value. The percentage is specified by the SplitValue property.

constants.name: xlSplitByCustomSplit
constants.description: Arbitrary slides are displayed in the second chart.

constants.name: xlSplitByValue
constants.description: Second chart displays values less than the value specified by the SplitValue property.
